text:
The previous topology has no headroom to work with. The diode-connected PMOS sets `pg` at about VDD−1.13 ≈ 0.67 V, and MN2's source sits at Veb ≈ 0.6 V, so MN2 is at the edge of triode. That broke the loop: line regulation came out near 1 V/V and TC was meaningless. At −40 °C (Veb ≈ 0.75 V) this stack cannot work at all.

The fix is to decouple the PMOS gate node from the BJT stack with a gain stage:
- **Gate-reference side:** MN2 is diode-connected on the `nb` side.
- **Gain node:** MN1 drives a high-impedance node `x`, loaded by MP1.
- **Driver:** `x` drives NMOS MN3 into the PMOS diode MP4 on `pg`.

This adds two inversions, so the loop feedback stays negative. It also lets `x` sit at about Vgs(MN3) ≈ 0.9 V, which is well above `ea`. Loop gain becomes high, which improves line regulation and PSRR.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "MN2 starved (pg=VDD-Vsg≈0.67V vs Veb 0.6V); loop broken -> line_reg~1V/V, bad TC. New topology: MN1 gain node x drives MN3 into PMOS diode, decoupling pg from BJT stack, adds high loop gain, headroom at -40C."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "R1":    (250e3, 120e3, 600e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "k3":    (11.5, 7.0, 16.0),       # R3/R1 ratio -> TC trim
    "vref_t":(0.95, 0.90, 1.0),       # target Vref -> sets R4
    "Lp":    (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid_p":(14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "gmid_n":(20.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "gmid3": (6.0, 3.0, 12.0),        # MN3 driver (sets V(x) level)
    "Cx":    (2e-12, 0.3e-12, 6e-12), # dominant-pole cap at x
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    mQ1 = 4
    mQ2 = mQ1 * N
    R1 = p["R1"]
    R3 = p["k3"] * R1
    dVbe = UT * math.log(N)
    Ip = dVbe / R1
    Veb = 0.65
    for _ in range(6):
        Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Ip / mQ1))
    Ic = Veb / R3
    I = Ip + Ic
    R4 = p["vref_t"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=Veb)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], 4.0, I, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror, pg set by diode MP4 driven by MN3
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # NMOS level-shift pair: MN2 diode on R1 side, MN1 amplifies into x
    n.dev("MN2", "nb", "nb", "eb", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN1", "x", "nb", "ea", "vss", mn)
    # driver stage
    n.dev("MN3", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", m3)
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=mQ1)
    n.R("R1", "eb", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mQ2)
    n.R("R3A", "ea", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3B", "eb", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("CX", "x", "vss", p["Cx"])
    # start-up: vref low -> sx high -> pull pg low
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 0.5)

    dVeb_dT = (Veb - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / 300.0
    dI_dT = dVeb_dT / R3 + (dVbe / 300.0) / R1
    vref = I * R4
    slope = dI_dT * R4
    curv = 0.004
    tc = (abs(slope) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    line_reg = vref * (mp.gds / I) * 1.5
    power = 1.8 * (4 * I + 20e-9)
    psrr = -db(line_reg) if line_reg > 0 else 60
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
